title: 18-Year-Old Shows No Remorse After Ending Man’s Life
description:
On April 4th, 2025.  Authorities arrested an 18-year-old man following a tragic incident. On Thursday evening, a pedestrian was struck by a white truck while crossing; the driver initially left the scene, and the victim unfortunately passed away at a local medical center. This is body-cam footage of the events.
